ownedRegions.text:
The in-widget settings panel supports location (name, latitude, longitude), calculation
method, Asr school, 12/24-hour, date format, and temperature units. A **location pin** beside
the location field identifies an estimated area, browser/saved browser position, or manually
selected site. Its title reports available accuracy in metres and original fix age; tap it
to request a browser position.
ownedRegions.boundary: Only location/evidence/persistence/conditional-host scope; no new sibling/table/whole-document/native approval.

ownedRegions.text: - **Browser location is optional and user-triggered.** The location pin requests one browser position after permission. Its reported accuracy may be known in metres or unknown; five decimal places do not measure accuracy. In an iframe, the local snippet includes `allow="geolocation"`, and the embedding parent's Permissions Policy and user grant also apply. Stripping delegation or restricting parent policy can block acquisition; coarse/manual setup remains available.
ownedRegions.boundary: Only location/evidence/persistence/conditional-host scope; no new sibling/table/whole-document/native approval.

ownedRegions.text: - **Acquisition and saving are separate.** A browser position retains its original acquisition time and reported accuracy; a saved browser position is a stored target and does not establish current presence. Saving settings does not renew a fix. Missing, malformed, nonpositive or future acquisition timestamps stay unknown; future timestamps have zero skew allowance against `Date.now()`. Portable URLs describe a configured destination and omit private acquisition history.
ownedRegions.boundary: Only location/evidence/persistence/conditional-host scope; no new sibling/table/whole-document/native approval.

ownedRegions.text: - **Storage outcome is measured.** Saved settings use this browser's storage. If writing is unavailable, changes still apply for the current session and Settings shows a retained warning. A partition can be writable and retain settings within that partition. Saving and persistence depend on the host's actual storage permissions and lifetime; blocked writes cause the session-only warning.
ownedRegions.boundary: Only location/evidence/persistence/conditional-host scope; no new sibling/table/whole-document/native approval.

ownedRegions.text: - **TablissNG conditions.** Coarse acquisition depends on permitted provider access; browser position depends on preserved delegation, parent policy and user grant; saving depends on writable host storage and its lifetime. These conditions are not a claim that a particular TablissNG version or partition policy has been qualified.
ownedRegions.boundary: Only location/evidence/persistence/conditional-host scope; no new sibling/table/whole-document/native approval.

ownedRegions.text:
- **`WidgetConfig`**: `{v, lat, lon, tz, label, method, school, time, datefmt, units, appearance, lp, seed, source, origin, savedAt, locationEvidence}`.
  `source ∈ {hash, localStorage, coarse-ip, browser-geolocation, place, manual, fallback}`; `origin`, when present,
  preserves the acquisition origin independently of the storage marker. Persisted under `salah_widget:config:v1`
  (separate from prayer/weather caches; every access wrapped in try/catch).
ownedRegions.boundary: Only location/evidence/persistence/conditional-host scope; no new sibling/table/whole-document/native approval.

ownedRegions.text:
- **Location evidence:** `{intent, source, accuracyM, acquiredAt, provider, area, bounds}`.
  `intent ∈ {fixed-site, device-position, coarse-area, unknown}` and evidence
  `source ∈ {hash, manual, place, browser-geolocation, coarse-ip, legacy, unknown}`. Coordinates select the
  target; this record does not certify the viewer's current presence. Browser `accuracyM` is finite numeric
  metres ≥ 0 or `null` (a reported 0 stays 0); decimal places do not establish accuracy. `acquiredAt` is a finite
  numeric epoch > 0 and ≤ actual `Date.now()`, or `null`. The future-timestamp skew allowance is zero;
  missing/nonpositive/future/malformed time stays unknown, never an age-0 clamp. `provider`/`area` retain
  available text bounded to 80/240 characters. `bounds` is `{south,north,west,east}` with finite ordered
  latitudes in [-90,90] and longitudes in [-180,180], or `null`; no radius is invented.
ownedRegions.boundary: Only location/evidence/persistence/conditional-host scope; no new sibling/table/whole-document/native approval.

ownedRegions.text:
- **Fix and persistence lifecycle:** `savedAt` is successful settings-write time, separate from `acquiredAt`.
  Saving label/units/method cannot renew a fix. Label/reverse naming retains compatible evidence; coordinate
  edits choose a manual fixed site and clear incompatible acquisition claims. Legacy records retain usable
  coordinates/preferences without substituting `savedAt`; reads do not destructively rewrite them. Saving
  browser-derived targets retains private evidence but downgrades the top-level source for old readers to a
  configured site. Portable hashes describe a fixed configured destination and omit private acquisition history.
  Denied persistence preserves useful in-memory metadata and prior saved bytes with the session-only warning;
  a writable partition may persist within its own permissions and lifetime. No new freshness/radius threshold
  or continuous location tracking follows from this schema.
ownedRegions.boundary: Only location/evidence/persistence/conditional-host scope; no new sibling/table/whole-document/native approval.

literalSourceAssertions.claim: LocationEvidence has exact intent/source/accuracyM/acquiredAt/provider/area/bounds fields and documented intent/source domains.
Coordinates choose a target; acquisition source does not certify current viewer presence.
Reported accuracy is finite numeric metres>=0 ornull; genuine0 stays0, decimals are not measured precision.
AcquiredAt is finite numeric positive<=actualDate.now; zero future allowance; malformed/missing/nonpositive/future isnull, never age0.
Provider/area text is bounded80/240; finite ordered south/north/west/east bounds have documented geographic ranges ornull, with no invented radius.
Successful savedAt is settings-write time separate from original acquiredAt; label/units/method resaves cannot renew a fix.
Label/reverse naming keeps compatible evidence; coordinate edits choose manual fixedsite and clear incompatible acquisition claims.
Legacy records keep usable targets/preferences without savedAt-as-fix; load does not destructively rewrite stored bytes.
Browser-derived save retains private evidence/origin and downgrades top-level source to configured site for old readers.
Portable hash selects fixed configured destination and omits private acquisition history.
Denied save leaves input evidence useful and existing bytes unchanged with session warning; writable partition depends on actual permissions/lifetime.
One user-triggered browser request reports available accuracy/originalfix age; unsupported/denied leaves manual choice usable, without new tracking/freshness thresholds.
Local iframe snippet delegates geolocation conditionally; actual parent policy and user grant still apply, with no claimedhost qualification.
Configuration origin is independent of storage marker and the private configuration key is separate from prayer/weather caches.
